description: This file contains shell functions for verifying signatures and metadata of firmware images in the OpenWrt firmware upgrade process. It defines functions for checking signatures and image metadata, involving tools like fwtool and ucert, and includes logic for device and version compatibility checks.

methods.name: fwtool_check_signature
methods.description: Checks the signature of a firmware image using fwtool and ucert, considering the REQUIRE_IMAGE_SIGNATURE and FORCE variables.

methods.name: fwtool_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image's metadata and device compatibility, including version checks, OEM validation, and possibly progressive compatibility adjustments.

calls: v "Use sysupgrade -F to override this check when downgrading or flashing to vendor firmware"
